presencetracker.name: Presence Tracker
presencetracker.desc: Presence Tracker helps permanent residents and citizenship applicants stay on top of Canada's physical presence requirements. Log your absences abroad and the app calculates your days in Canada in real time.
presencetracker.positioning: Most day-counters count days. Presence Tracker counts the days IRCC actually credits you.

explainer.title: Physical presence, explained
explainer.p1: To become a Canadian citizen, permanent residents generally need to have been physically present in Canada for at least 1,095 days (3 years) <citCit>{ircc}</citCit> within the 5 years immediately before applying. Permanent residents also need to meet a separate residency obligation — at least 730 days (2 years) of physical presence within any 5-year period <citPr>{ircc}</citPr> — whether they're renewing their PR card or applying for a new one.
explainer.p2: Both counts only look at time actually spent inside Canada — every trip abroad, even a short one, subtracts from the total. Tracking this by hand across years of travel is exactly the kind of tedious, error-prone bookkeeping Presence Tracker was built to remove: log your trips once, and it keeps a running, accurate count of your physical presence days for citizenship or PR applications. Presence Tracker includes PDF and CSV export, so you can print your data or manage it outside the app.
explainer.p3: This is not legal advice — always confirm your specific situation with IRCC or an immigration professional — but it's the number every applicant needs to get right.

whatsNew.label: What's new
whatsNew.kickerText: Presence Tracker now understands not just where you were, but what status you held while you were there — and it speaks five languages.
whatsNew.statusHistoryText: Record every period of status you've held — visitor, student, work permit, permanent resident — with the half-day pre-PR credit applied automatically, capped at 365 days. Unrecorded stretches are flagged.
whatsNew.backupText: Save everything to a single file and bring it back on a new phone. Your data has never left your device; now it doesn't have to be trapped there either.

trust.label: Your data, your device
trust.title: Your travel history never leaves your phone.
trust.text: Presence Tracker has no account system, no servers, and no analytics. It makes no network requests at all. Everything you enter is stored in a database on your device, and the only way data leaves is when you export it yourself. Both the App Store and Google Play list this app as collecting no data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summaryText: Presence Tracker stores all your data locally on your device only. We do not collect any personal data, use no analytics, and the app never connects to our servers.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: At Application Development Canada ("we", "us", or "our"), Company Number 76826 5175, we value your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes our privacy practices for the Presence Tracker mobile application (the "App").
This Policy applies to the Presence Tracker mobile application and related services provided by Application Development Canada.

sections.title: 2. We do not collect your data
paragraphs: Presence Tracker is designed to operate entirely on your device. We do not collect, transmit, store, or process any personal data from you or your device.
items: All trip information you enter (travel dates, destinations, reasons for travel) is stored exclusively in local storage on your device.
We do not have access to your trip data, nor can we view, retrieve, modify, or delete it.
We do not collect crash reports, analytics, usage statistics, or any device information.
We do not use third-party analytics SDKs, tracking pixels, or advertising identifiers.
The App does not connect to our servers or transmit any data to us.
sections.closing: Because we do not collect any personal data, many data privacy regulations (including GDPR, PIPEDA, CCPA/CPRA, LGPD, and others) do not impose data controller obligations on us regarding user data. However, we maintain this Policy for transparency and to inform you of your rights regarding data stored on your own device.

sections.title: 3. Children's privacy
paragraphs: Because we do not collect any data, there is no risk of us inadvertently collecting information from children. The App's age restrictions are governed by our Terms of Use.

sections.title: 4. Your rights and your device data
paragraphs: Although we do not hold your data, you retain full control over the trip information stored locally on your device. You may:
items: Export, modify, or delete your data directly within the App settings.
Delete all data by removing the App from your device.
Back up your data using the App's own backup export, or your device's backup (for example iCloud).
sections.closing: We cannot assist with data recovery, export, or deletion because we have no access to your device or its contents.

sections.title: 5. Security
paragraphs: Because your data never leaves your device, its security depends entirely on your device's own protections. We strongly recommend:
items: Keeping your device and operating system up to date.
Using a device passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID.
Enabling device encryption if available.
sections.closing: Backup files you export from the App are unencrypted and readable by any app or person you share them with. Store and share them with the same care you would give any other document containing your travel history.

sections.title: 6. Third-party services
paragraphs: This Policy does not apply to third-party websites, products, or services accessed through links within the App. Those sites operate independently and have their own privacy practices.

sections.title: 7. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will post an updated version within the App. Your continued use of the App after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised Policy.

sections.title: 8. Language
paragraphs: This Policy is drafted in English. Any translation is provided for your convenience only. In the event of any inconsistency between the English version and a translation, the English version governs, except where applicable law requires otherwise.
